about: Concept codebook for samurai zen music, written from the 2026-10-25 run (seeded with @AetherJourneyMusic). Matched on title + description; counted by `viral_research.py concepts --niche samurai-zen`.

concepts.name: Japanese-word title (kanji concept name)
concepts.note: the video is named after one Japanese word, in capitals and/or kanji: KUMAMICHI（熊道）, KOI — 鯉, IKIGAI, SYOUKAKU（松鶴）

concepts.name: shakuhachi / koto zen ambient
concepts.note: traditional instruments + a calm place: shakuhachi, koto, bamboo, water fountain, temple

concepts.name: samurai lo-fi / hip-hop beats
concepts.note: lo-fi or hip-hop beats with a samurai or Edo/Meiji setting

concepts.name: samurai jazz / reggae / funk fusion
concepts.note: an unexpected modern genre with Japanese instruments: reggae jazz, funk, shamisen groove

concepts.name: epic taiko / war drums
concepts.note: short epic pieces: taiko, war drums, battle, warrior power

concepts.name: philosophy / way of the warrior
concepts.note: a principle as the hook: ikigai, bushido, wabi-sabi, stoic discipline, the way of…

concepts.name: animal or spirit guide
concepts.note: an animal or spirit as the video's character: bear's path, koi, tiger, crane, fox, sacred beast, dragon

concepts.name: season or moment
concepts.note: a season, festival or moment of the day: sakura, autumn, winter snow, moonlight, Halloween

concepts.name: focus / study / work
concepts.note: the use is the promise: deep focus, study, work, productivity

concepts.name: sleep / healing / anxiety
concepts.note: the use is the promise: sleep, healing, stress and anxiety relief

concepts.name: game / anime soundtrack cover
concepts.note: covers of game or anime music: Ghost of Tsushima, Sekiro, anime OSTs

concepts.name: black samurai / Yasuke
concepts.note: the Black samurai angle: Yasuke (Oda Nobunaga's African retainer), black samurai, African samurai
